notes: Buildings now come from OpenStreetMap: each one sits where it really is, at its real size and orientation (about 145,000 across the cities, up to 30,000 in the largest). Hospitals, schools, markets, mosques, water and power plants use the real tagged buildings where OpenStreetMap has them. Where OpenStreetMap has few buildings mapped, the gaps are filled in as before
Every street in each city is drawn from OpenStreetMap, with main roads heavier than side streets
The national road network (motorways, trunk roads, primary and secondary roads) is drawn across the map under the MSRs
